name: 44702 · Canton, OH
findings: ZIP 44702 (Canton) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44702 (Canton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
